A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. Pages 2–19 have identical extracted text and rendered images; differences are confined to first-page authorship, correspondence, publication information, and layout.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on ImageNet-LT, Places365-LT, and iNaturalist2018 in Tables 5–7, plus ablations and additional experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results in Tables 5–7 and the experimental analyses in Appendix E, including the synthetic-data experiment in E.9.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same backdoor adjustment and fusion of outputs from CLIP, OpenCLIP, and MetaCLIP. No algorithm, loss, model component, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same three main benchmarks, modified Places365 distributions in Appendix E.4, and six-class synthetic dataset in E.9. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including Tables 5–7 and the appendix comparisons involving GLA variants, decoupling, and training from scratch.

E3.justification: Training budgets, backbones, metrics, class-group definitions, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same hyperparameters, and Appendix E.9 retains the same synthetic-data sample counts and train/test combinations.

E4.justification: Section 5.2 and Appendix E retain all analyses, including semantic-factor ablations, classifier effects, altered imbalance scenarios, occlusion examples, heatmaps, and synthetic confounder experiments.

E5.justification: Appendix E.4 retains averaging over three constructed datasets per scenario. Neither version changes run-count disclosures, seed information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Tables 5–7 retain overall accuracies of 53.01 on Places365-LT, 79.57 on ImageNet-LT, and 82.01 on iNaturalist2018; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, Equations 1–10, the causal graph, and the associated assumptions and derivations are identical. The mathematical discussions in Appendices B–D are also retained without revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about parameter imbalance, limitations of re-balancing, and the proposed causal adjustment. No scientific contribution or claim changes.

C2.justification: Interpretations of parameter imbalance and incomplete semantic factors are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same qualifications about collecting tail-class data and the computational cost of increasing the number of semantic factors.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, model descriptions, and synthetic-data generation instructions in Appendices A, D, and E are identical. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The references, Section 6 related work, and Appendix C comparisons with earlier causal approaches are identical. The added first-page proceedings notice does not change research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds an equal-contribution marker for Jiangmeng Li, changes the corresponding author from Jiahao Chen to Bing Su, and updates publication/version information. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds a proceedings/copyright footer and slightly adjusts first-page text placement and the affiliation/contact block. All figures, tables, and page layouts on pages 2–19 are identical.

improvement.justification: The revision changes administrative information and first-page formatting. The scientific exposition, methods, results, analyses, and reproducibility information—including all appendices—are unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
